name: telepathy
description: Telepathy for your coding agents: this Codex session can message Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and other agent sessions on this machine, and their messages start a turn here. Everything stays on this machine in ~/.telepathy; no network calls, no telemetry.

interface.longDescription: Lets this Codex session find, message and be messaged by the other coding-agent sessions on this machine: Claude Code, other Codex sessions, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Grok, Devin, Antigravity, Kimi Code, Qwen Code and Kilo Code. Incoming messages start a new turn here, so two agents can coordinate on their own, for example a UI session asking the backend session for an API change. Local only: messages go through ~/.telepathy on this machine, with no network calls and no telemetry.
defaultPrompt: List the other agent sessions on this machine
Ask the Claude Code session in this repo what it is working on
Tell the other sessions in this repo that the API change landed
